title: Truly Madly Deeply

cues.en: I'll be your dream, I'll be your wish, I'll be your fantasy
cues.zh: 我願成為你的夢想、你的心願、你的幻想
cues.text: I'll be your dream, I'll be your wish, I'll be your fantasy

cues.en: I'll be your hope, I'll be your love, be everything that you need
cues.zh: 我會成為你的希望，我會成為你的愛，成為你需要的一切
cues.text: I'll be your hope, I'll be your love, be everything that you need

cues.en: I love you more with every breath truly, madly, deeply do
cues.zh: 我每次呼吸都更愛你，真的，瘋狂地，深深地做
cues.text: I love you more with every breath truly, madly, deeply do

cues.en: I will be strong, I will be faithful 'cause I'm counting on
